headline: Profit surges on lighter investment charges, steady growth
summary_short: Prudential's Q2 FY2026 net income rose 84.8% y/y to $985M ($2.80 diluted EPS, +89.2%), as smaller realized-investment and market-risk-benefit losses offset a bigger annual-assumption-update charge; after-tax adjusted operating income grew to $1.438B ($4.08/share) on higher PGIM fees and International growth.
summary_long: Revenue rose 14.1% y/y to $15.66B. Net income rose 84.8% y/y to $985M ($2.80 diluted EPS, +89.2%) even though the quarter absorbed a larger annual-assumption-update charge ($299M vs $134M after-tax), because total pre-tax reconciling items were less negative ($649M vs $925M) on a swing to pre-tax gains from divested/run-off businesses ($135M vs $12M) and a smaller market-risk-benefit loss ($71M vs $426M). Adjusted operating income rose to $1.438B ($4.08/share, +14.0%) on higher PGIM fees and International growth in Brazil, partly offset by the Prudential of Japan sales suspension. Total cash fell 8.9% to $15.16B; long-term debt rose 5.4% to $19.66B; equity rose 3.3% to $31.58B. No forward guidance was issued.
